strictWorkflow.reason: Pinned native QCAD resaving produces the same baseline ownership repairs; strict zero-repair result is not overridden.

supportedScope: ASCII AC1015 with whitelisted structural records and explicit resolved ownership
LINE, CIRCLE, INSERT; model space; ordinary named blocks
Positive uniform scale and quarter-turn rotations; matching explicit units
excludedClaims: Unseen customer-file or other native CAD consumer validation
deliveryBoundary: The product exports a byte-patched original donor, never a QCAD-resaved merged drawing.

snapshotReproducibility.reason: ezdxf can synthesize absent GUID header values on loading; the full snapshot invariant compares before/after the same in-memory audit without rewriting source files.
